name: Report failed executions to an HTTP endpoint with an error trigger

parameters.content:
## Report failed executions to an HTTP endpoint with an error trigger

### How it works

1. Starts automatically when a workflow that names this one as its error workflow fails.
2. Reads the failure payload n8n passes in: workflow name and id, execution URL, error message, and the node that failed.
3. Posts those five fields to an HTTP endpoint of your choice, so the alert carries a direct link to the failed run instead of just a name.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Point the HTTP Request node at your own endpoint: a Slack or Discord incoming webhook, an internal alerting API, or anything that accepts JSON.
- [ ] Attach a Header Auth credential if that endpoint requires one.
- [ ] Open Settings > Error workflow on every workflow you want covered and select this one.
- [ ] Break one workflow on purpose once to confirm the report actually arrives.

### Customization

Swap the HTTP Request node for the Slack, Telegram, or email node if you prefer a native integration. Note that an error workflow only fires on a thrown error: a run that finishes green while writing nothing never triggers it, so add an item count check and a Stop and Error node to the workflow you are protecting.

## Catch and report failures

The Error Trigger is not wired to anything. You select this workflow under Settings > Error workflow on each workflow you want covered.
